propositions: Extract identity transition call graph (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID re-key) from BindingStore into new BindingLifecycle module while preserving exact existing behaviors and facade signatures.
bind_confirm must remain last-writer-wins on the forward entry and pop exactly one differing old reverse key with no sweep, no ambiguity detection, and no abort.
Stale reverse entries are removed only in four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind with sweep, re-key old-key pop, and _retire operations.
Numeric-ID re-key (step 4 of note_absent_or_rekey) re-keys moved issues instead of retiring them; facade coordinator delegates to BindingLifecycle.rekey and falls through to note_absent on False.
Every valid bind/confirm/unbind transition leaves at most one forward and one matching reverse identity verified by table-driven tests reloading both indexes from disk.
Legacy records without numeric IDs retain current behavior and both-index outcomes without re-key mutations.
